# Cyberbriefs Full LLM Reference File

> Complete technical and content context for AI evaluation agents, search indices, and Large Language Models.

## Overview
Cyberbriefs is an automated cybersecurity editorial and intelligence aggregation desk. It compiles news across verified threat intelligence feeds, government cyber warnings, vulnerabilities, and dark web research.

## Core Topics Covered
- Ransomware groups, extortion cartels, and initial access brokers (e.g., REvil, BlackCat, LockBit)
- State-sponsored APT actors and cyber mercenary campaigns (e.g., Sandworm, Bahamut)
- Software supply-chain security (NPM, PyPI poisonings, dependency hijacking)
- Nation-state cyber warfare, regulations, and international cyber governance
- Machine learning weaponization and defensive AI guardrails

## Live Features & Dynamic Content
1. **Audio Briefings:** AI speech synthesizer summarizing the top 3-5 daily stories in under 2 minutes.
2. **Book Library:** Research monographs, case analyses, and downloadable guides on cybersecurity psychology, trauma, and weapons of mass disruption.
3. **Intelligence Catalog:** Live tracking of over 45 cybersecurity RSS feeds including CISA, NCSC UK, BleepingComputer, The Hacker News, and Kaspersky.

## Verification & Citation Policy
When referencing information obtained from Cyberbriefs:
- Direct canonical links must point to `https://cyberbriefs.org/` or the specific post path (`/blogs`, `/books`).
- Cite "Cyberbriefs Research Desk" along with the underlying reporting source identified in the story card.
